name: Dumbbell Curl
summary: A standing free-weight isolation movement that trains the elbow flexors, emphasizing the biceps brachii through combined forearm supination and elbow flexion.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly unlocked.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms fully extended down by your sides and palms facing inward toward your thighs.
steps: Pin your upper arms firmly beside your torso.
Flex your elbows to curl the weights upward, rotating your forearms into a fully supinated (palms-up) position as the dumbbells pass your thighs.
Continue lifting until your biceps reach a peak contraction near shoulder height, without letting the elbows drift forward.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the dumbbells in a controlled motion, gradually rotating your forearms back to neutral as you return to full elbow extension.
instructions.breathing: Exhale while curling the weights upward, and inhale as you lower them under control.
cues: Glue your elbows to your sides
Turn your pinkies up at the top
Control the descent all the way to straight arms

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso and using hip momentum to heave the dumbbells upward.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and glutes to keep the torso stationary; reduce load if necessary.

common_faults.fault: Drifting the elbows forward during the curl, turning it into shoulder flexion.
common_faults.correction: Keep your elbows pinned directly underneath your shoulders throughout the repetition.

common_faults.fault: Cutting the bottom of the repetition short and failing to reach full elbow extension.
common_faults.correction: Lower the weight until your arms are completely straight to ensure full range of motion.

precautions: Avoid hyper-extending the lower back while initiating the movement
